instructions: Pick the single best option per question, strictly from the packets. Output {"answers":{id:LETTER},"ambiguous":[id]}.

questions.stem: Object Relations share the marker “neutral stance” with Bowen Family Systems, so that marker cannot tell them apart. Which of these IS distinctive of Object Relations?

Within Self Psychology: which term matches this description?

“The patient experiences the therapist as someone like himself, “that person is like me.””

Within Satir Communications Therapy: which term matches this description?

“Attacking others, fault finder, dictator, boss.”

questions.stem:
Client Centered therapy has no clear phases of treatment, and the packet says so. It also warns that the exam may still ask what a Client Centered therapist does in the initial or middle stage.

What answer shape is correct there?

options.B: Unconditional positive regard, empathy, therapist congruence, and promotion of self-acceptance

questions.stem:
A mother brings her child to therapy. Both are in the room. The therapist works from Experiential/Symbolic therapy.

What is the therapist's initial intervention?

options.D: Discuss with the mother the need to include the entire family in therapy

questions.stem:
The packet singles out one model as the only therapy concerned with the past three generations of the family.

Which model?

A son habitually sits in the chair between his two parents. The therapist asks him to move to a chair on the opposite side of the room so he is not caught in the middle.

This Structural intervention is:

This is:

During sessions with a particular client, the therapist repeatedly notices that they themselves feel annoyed. On reflection the therapist recognises the annoyance did not originate with them; they have taken on and begun to identify with a feeling the client put onto them.

An Object Relations therapist would name this:

A client begins to cry in session. Rather than saying “you seem sad,” the therapist says: “I see you tearing up, I'm wondering what you're experiencing right now.”

This illustrates which Gestalt method?

A family comes in for therapy and nobody is speaking.

What would an Experiential/Symbolic therapist do?

options.C: Wait silently for the family to take initiative
